title: Inspect the SVM result archive
description: You follow linear and kernel model parameters into one NumPy file.

steps.description: You create artifacts and begin svm_run.npz. Its first entries identify the dataset and store scaling values mu and sigma.
You include both linear models' weights and biases. C and GAMMA become separate array entries for the kernel model settings.

steps.question: Which archive entry identifies the selected support-vector row indices?
steps.answer: ksvm_sv_idx stores ksvm.sv_idx. The same line stores kernel alphas and bias under separate names.

steps.description: You add the test features and labels, then list artifacts. The recorded listing contains svm_run.npz.
